intro: One steel-framed, factory-finished design, built in sizes from a 25 m² garden room to a four-bedroom home, at one published rate per square metre.
visualNote: Every image on this page is a computer-generated visualisation published by Don Modular Homes. None is a photograph of a completed build.
standfirst: Anthracite steel cladding, a glazed gable and a timber deck: the same building, shown in the supplier's own visualisations.
included: G550 galvanised steel frame (C4 coastal-rated); 200 mm insulation, wall U-value about 0.18 W/m²K; anthracite steel cladding; thermally broken aluminium windows and doors; two skylights; full bathroom and fitted kitchen; underfloor heating; 5 kW air conditioning; fire sprinkler system.
excludedCosts: Foundations, delivery, crane and installation, and connection to water, electricity and drainage are quoted separately after a site assessment. VAT treatment is not stated.

products.name: Garden Room
products.summary: The Don Modular Home at its smallest sizes, sold as a garden room with the same frame, insulation, heating, bathroom and kitchenette as the homes.

products.name: One-Bedroom Home
products.summary: A studio layout at the smaller sizes and a separate bedroom from about 28.8 m², with a full bathroom and fitted kitchen.

products.name: Two-Bedroom Home
products.summary: Two double bedrooms, a bathroom and open-plan kitchen and living, in the largest single module.

products.name: Three-Bedroom Home
products.summary: Built from more than one factory module joined on site, and laid out to your brief.

products.name: Four-Bedroom Home
products.summary: A larger multi-module home laid out to your brief.

planningNote: A garden room that is not lived in can be exempt from planning permission within set limits. A home in the garden is different: depending on its size, it may need permission or a notification under the newer rules for detached units, and every condition applies. Don Modular Homes publishes its own guidance; treat it as the supplier's view and check your plans with your local authority.
